descriptionHtml:
Bug B22 · fixed on 43c38a4f · was P1 · no longer counted

Billing follows the admission badge, not the template chosen at Generate: New Admission / Consult patients written as SOAP get admission / consult codes instead of 99231–99233

Tickets: UAT TC-06 (TFA-92584 ready for qa); TFA-92596 AC 1 ready for pr (fix in PR #103) · counts as a QA bug: yes (fix in PR #103) · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92584): AC 6 itself says only 'preselected and changeable'; billing following the template comes from UAT TC-06 and TFA-92596. Q9 waits on Daniela. Re-test 2026-10-15 on 43c38a4f (PR #110): fixed. Local: 16 server-job cells and UAT step 4 in the app; dev: d1–d8 and step 4 (New Admission + SOAP gives 99231).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-18/S04

Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S24 Badge x template chosen at Generate -> billing family: the badge only pre-selects, the template decides (incl. a badge change after Generate)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U13 The badge's only effect at Generate is the pre-selection: the note and its billing follow the template chosen at Generate, so a hand override decides the billing family (Hospital SOAP progress bills … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6)
  • U9 The physician still sees the template picker at Generate and can change the pre-selected template by hand; changing the template does not change the badge, and Generate writes the note in the templat … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6)
  • U8 The badge pre-selects the template at Generate: Hospital New Admission -> H&P, Follow-up -> SOAP progress, Consult -> Consult note; … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6; TFA-92584 AC 7)
  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 1)
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3) (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.3; TFA-92584 AC 7)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Session fixture; Hospital patient and resident untouched

When H1: Hospital, set New Admission (H&P pre-selected), change Note Format by hand to SOAP progress, Generate, wait for the Post-Round billing block. H2: back on the Encounter tab change the badge to Consult (Consult note pre-selected), change Note Format by hand to SOAP progress, Regenerate, wait for billing. …

Then H1 and H2 bill from 99231-99233, never 99221-99223 or 99252-99255; after the badge change on a generated note the status is saved and Consult note is pre-selected for the regenerate; N1 bills from 99304-99306 (the hand-picked SNF admission), never 99307-99310

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-06 'The badge only pre-selects the template' + TFA-92584 AC 6 (U13; Q9 for Daniela). oracle.mjs on the Post-Round billing block ('Billing Suggestion · Physician Verify Before Submitting', BillingCard.tsx): Hospital mustContain '9923' with mustNotContain 99221-99223, 99252-99255, 99238, 99239; Nursing Home mustContain '9930' with mustNotContain 99307-99310; …

Where it ran: dev unit U44; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92584 ready for qa; TFA-92596 ready for qa

The billing suggestion follows the badge, not the template chosen at Generate: a New Admission patient written up as a SOAP progress note is billed 99221 and a Consult as SOAP is billed 99252, instead of 99231–99233.

Evidence: dev U44 (ledger #44). Already dev report §2 #3. The fix is in open PR #103 (TFA-92596, ready for pr). TC-06 Q9 is the same question. NH (SNF admission -> 9930x) passes, and a badge change after Generate is saved.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
